column1: # The Duskbloods (network test, Switch 2), FromSoftware's engine (Dantelion2), SDK 20.5.19 built for the Switch 2, NVN2. Started from the provisional profile the NSP
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (C / libc), subsdk1 (C / libc)
# main.npdm's ThreadInfo allows cores 0-5 (the NPLN threads run on 3-4, mask 0x18). With the Switch's 0-2, gRPC's per-CPU call counters (channelz, sized by the highest core in
# GetInfo's mask, indexed by GetCurrentProcessorNumber) were written one entry past their end from core 4: the store of the call's start time (main+0x51d808) landed on the next
# heap object, an NPLN task's allocator pointer, and the task crashed on destruction (main+0x39cf10) after every NPLN request
# Compute shaders that pick an image from c2's image table at run time: Ryujinx makes those 32-entry arrays indexed by the handle's texture ID, which the replay fills with
# the bound image slots while c2 holds slot indices (nvn_refl.m / nvn_mtl.m). Images whose handle comes from memory (the fog volume, GXFogVolume_*) use the image pool instead
# The game sets near = 0 (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode) at boot: the pipeline archive built with the app must be made for it, or none of its pipelines match and the device builds them all
# The engine plans its memory from QueryMemoryInfo (main+0x1d7ac40). It takes plan row 4 of its table (main+0x5a63340) when total + virtual address memory usage is 9 GiB or
# more, else row 3. Row 4 sets the heap to total - used - 120 MB and takes heap - 7,304 MB as the root block its heaps come from: with a pool of 9 GiB exactly that block was 1,728 MB,
# 20 MB short of the first four heaps (990 + 340 + 279 + 139 MB), and heap G failed (Dantelion2 Panic, CSMemory.cpp 3771). Row 4 is a plan for more memory than a console gives
# (a larger pool only moved the failure to the next heap); row 3 (root block heap - 5,718 MB) fits. So the pool is just under 9 GiB. The Switch 2's real pool is not measured
# the NPDM declares 2 MB of system resource
